messages.author: 262bfcbf6d4ecc3a
messages.subject: reinstalling in 2.10
parts:
My R locked up trying to reinstall ggplot2 on multiple machines in the
latest R. For those who had similar problems I solved it by not
installing dependencies at the same and putting them in separately.

messages.author: cb25d91fd630a4e5
messages.subject: Re: reinstalling in 2.10
parts:

ggplot2 as a dependency while installing the ez package, and it went
